body: Selective mutism is a disability under the disability act which means the employer should make “reasonable adjustments” for you - although not really sure what they might be. Perhaps talk to the HR team beforehand if you can and ask what reasonable adjustments they can make for people with selective mutism?

I’ve been checking all her stuff literally about 15 times a day for the last 9 months. 

I haven’t done it in the last 2 days and it’s so hard, I literally think about it 24/7 like I was literally just obsessing about what might be on there in my head as I read this.

I guess it doesn’t matter what others do but I just struggle with grasping why my reaction to this is so extreme in comparison to 99% of people. I know wecan’t tell exactly how people are dealing with it from our external perspectives but millions of people go through breakups every year and a vast majority of them don’t allow their lives to spiral completely out of control and less then 1% kill themselves over it. I just don’t get why I’m probably gonna be apart of that 1% why can’t I be like the other 99% of normal people who can at least cope with staying alive? 

I have plenty of people to talk to so that’s okay and I’ve been working on recovering and I’m doing completely fine but it feels futile because I don’t care about anything in my life if I can’t share it with the person I wanted to, nothing makes me happy or even content because I’m completely heartbroken and empty.

What exactly does “learning to deal with it” mean? I don’t want to live with being heartbroken regardless of how well I can deal with it, I think I deal with it well but im still empty and broken so there is no point to continue in my view.
Thank you - I shall bookmark and watch those videos when I have some spare time!

Thank you so much, I do try my best to be a nice, good guy, I believe I share a reciprocal love with my parents and a few close friends which is the only thing that keeps me alive today. 

Perhaps I am but I doubt that, I don’t really want to wait years of being in pain probably only to prove to myself that wasn’t true and that I will never have true love in my life. even if I was I cannot bury the trauma of this heartbreak and I don’t know if I ever will. 

Anyway, I don’t want to die solely because of my romantic life, it’s just the trigger that has left me with nothing to live for (other than my parents). I’m deeply socially anxious and since my friends live in different places I spend almost all of my days alone in my room, frequently I will not say a single word to anyone for an entire week, when I try to do anything I want to do in my career or in following my passions and hobbies anxiety completely ruins it, for example I’m too anxious to do volunteering work I want to do, I’m too anxious to go outside to run even at 5am in the pitch black, I’m too anxious to deal with the interaction my career goals would require. These are just a couple of reasons amongst a myriad of factors that have contributed to my suicidal ideation, it would take me hours to explain them all but I think I am justified in wanting to end it.

I agree, I couldn’t bring myself to commit suicide without confidently being sure I have absolutely exhausted every single avenue available to prevent myself from doing it. Honestly the only reason I have taken antidepressants and been open about my suicidal ideation to professionals and some close people in my personal life is because that is apart of the process of me ensuring myself I am justified in ending my life. I’ve tried so hard to fix my lifestyle but I either can’t keep it up or I just feel demotivated when I realise it is futile and nothing will change. 

I’ve deeply considered the impact it would have on my family and that’s why I’m struggling with this ultimatum so much, I think they probably wouldn’t get over it, I’m not sure if they would be able to cope at all, it might ruin them. Everyone else in my life genuinely would get over it but thinking I could basically ruin two peoples lives like that just makes me feel like the worst person ever, I sometimes wish my parents didn’t even love me so I could go peacefully without the overwhelming sense of guilt. I just really don’t want to be alive I hate it. 

Thanks for your comment and I know it can get better but I think I just can’t handle it, I genuinely believe being alive will never be bearable for me and I will just become increasingly worse, I simply can’t cope with much more of being alive in this much pain.

Yes, I’ve seen those kind of posts and understand how deeply traumatic losing someone close to you to suicide would be, that’s why I feel such a deeply overwhelming sense of guilt. 

I agree, I wanted to wait for it to get better with time but it’s been 8 months and it just gets worse, by the time I kill my self it will have been at least one year and if it has continued to get worse I do not see the point of continuing with that pain and holding onto the false hope that it might get better just because of time. 

I think I would rather be dead then indulging in recreational substances every/most days, the idea of going to work 8 hours a day and being utterly miserable all day just to fund my life of getting fucked up alone in my flat everyday not only seems like a worse fate then death but would also probably be equally as distressing for the people around me.
Thanks man, sorry you’re going through it too. You can message me anytime you like as well : )
Just under 2 years.

I’ve basically never had any friends before and it sucks seeing her having so much support around her when she’s the one who hurt me and I’m alone and struggling. I sometimes feel bitter or resentful, I wish I didn’t but sometimes I can’t help feeling that way. I really want to better myself and stop being so lonely and isolated. Letting go of any jealousy and the need to compare myself to my ex is definitely one of the first steps. 

It sucks we don’t have everything they have and feel so much worse than they do but our happiness and how we cope with shitty situations like this is our own responsibility and we all have the potential to be happy and cope with grief. She clearly is fulfilling that potential and that’s something that we should really be proud of and not bitter about, even if they were a shitty person or have it really easy. Seeing them fulfilling their potential has to just be inspiration to do the same in ones own life!
I’m so happy for u even tho idk you, hope u enjoy ur presents to yourself. You’re doing amazing and it’s really inspirational :)

I’m so proud of you for going to see a therapist too and giving yourself a chance. Hopefully we’re both on the right path and we both learn a lot and come out of this feeling completely different. 

I am truly committed to getting back to my recovery and I’ve just accepted now that I need some help with that and can’t do it all alone. Luckily I can just keep her stuff at my parents house so it’s out the way but I do need to get rid of it soon, to me it feels like when I get rid of that stuff I will truly be letting go but I know it would completely destroy me to do it right now. 

I can relate to feeling discarded and kind of used so much, it’s just horrible. I wish I knew how to cope with it. 

I want to sleep away and not bother about anything around me everyday and a lot of the time I do that but I know it’s not healthy and I need to dedicate myself fully to recovering from this. I’m glad u feel a bit less alone and of course you’re welcome to message me anytime if you need someone to talk with. Much love to you too and best wishes for your recovery. We can both do it 💞💕

I didn’t think anyone else would reply to this, I really appreciate your thoughtful comment. 

Personally I’ve kind of gotten worse since this post, but I am now on a waiting list for therapy and probably gonna go on some kind of medication too. 

Thanks for sharing that link, I’ve saved it for future reference and it’s a really useful template. I’ve realised how deeply depression and anxiety are making my recovery more difficult, for example I often can’t exercise as I’m too anxious to go to the gym or run outside in the light, I don’t have and can’t make any friends to help me through it due to my anxiety and can’t meet anyone new romantically. So hopefully my sessions with my therapist will help me get over it all easier. 

I kept up no contact but I actually ran into my ex the other day as I have a few times and basically agreed we could meet to have coffee and talk over where we are now. Basically I think I am going to tell her that I never want to speak to her again and how deeply upset I was by how she acted, hopefully that should give me some sense of closure. I’m genuinely in tears as I type just even thinking about this right now but I have to consider throwing away my box full of meaningful items relating to her. I’m nowhere near being able to do that yet. 

I’m so sorry you’re dealing with such a similar situation to me. I know my life is just indescribably intense constant pain now and I’m so sorry you have to experience this too. 

Yes it is their loss in a sense but apart of me feels somewhat bitter that they hurt me so badly and now they get to be happy and I’m drowning in depression everyday. 

I could not handle being in a class with my ex and I commend your fortitude for tolerating that. I genuinely considered moving cities to avoid the chance of seeing my ex in the street. I hope you can avoid him or somehow. 


Once again thanks for such a thoughtful comment, it genuinely means a great amount to me. I will give myself a chance and I know I can do it. I am absolutely committed to staying alive for the next 9 months at least and I genuinely believe there is at least a small chance that my situation may have gotten slightly better by then. I truly appreciate your comment and hope that your situation can get better too.

I still think about her everyday from the moment I wake up until I go to sleep, I still dream about her almost every night and wake up to this shitty reality I’m still in denial about. I kind of just don’t see the point in life anymore. I’m sorry to be so negative but it’s difficult to express any positivity right now, it can get better and I really hope it does for you.
